name: The majority voted against a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/senate/?id=2019-07-23.11.2) introduced by SA Senator [Anne Ruston](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/sa/anne_ruston) (Liberal), which means it failed. ### Motion text > *That the provisions of paragraphs (5) to (8) of [standing order 111](https://www.aph.gov.au/Parliamentary_Business/Chamber_documents/Senate_chamber_documents/standingorders/previouseditions/~/~/link.aspx?_id=5845FC0FA06C4184AE526E948368E472&_z=z) not apply to the following bills, allowing them to be considered during this period of sittings:* > >> *Future Drought Fund Bill 2019* >> >> *Future Drought Fund (Consequential Amendments) Bill 2019.*
